elements.description: This background element depicts the skeletal remains of what appears to be a large creature, likely a dragon or serpentine beast. A prominent vertebral column extends downward from the center, showing individual vertebrae in detailed anatomical structure. The bones are rendered with clean, precise linework typical of manga art, using solid black lines of varying weights to define the skeletal structure. The background is filled with deep black space, creating stark contrast against the white bones. Diagonal support lines or cables stretch across the composition, suggesting this skeleton is suspended or mounted as a display. The art style employs minimal shading, relying primarily on bold line work and negative space to create depth and dimensionality. The overall composition creates an ominous, cathedral-like atmosphere with the skeletal remains dominating the frame from above.
